purpose: Assess recent symbolic-protocol and action-compression work against Tacit's LLM-to-LLM communication estimand.

sources.title: When LLMs Develop Languages: Symbolic Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
sources.version: arXiv:2606.29354v1, 2026-06-28; authors' code repository identifies ICML 2026
facts_used: CLSR evolves reusable LSF lexicons, grammars, and usage constraints from exemplars; profiles them and routes, ensembles, or composes them at inference time

Reports seven reasoning benchmarks and four open-weight backbones; the Qwen3-8B table reports MMLU-Pro 60.4/96 completion tokens for CLSR versus 60.2/276 for Raw CoT, GPQA-Main 47.7/228 versus 49.1/1085, and MATH500 86.8/257 versus 87.2/878

Main cost counts all online generated completion tokens including router and intermediate outputs, while input tokens are excluded; appendix introduces a cache-aware diagnostic and notes LSF/profile/router input overhead can be around 0.5 to 2k tokens

Paper uses 200 to 2000 training exemplars for LSF synthesis, LSF cards range about 500 to 2000 tokens, and offline evolution takes several days on 8 RTX 4090s; authors frame this as one-time amortizable setup but omit it from the headline serving frontier

The official repository distinguishes offline fixture, adapter run, and exact paper protocol reproduction and says named table reproduction requires exact manifests, model revisions, evaluators, seeds, and release artifacts
The official repository states MIT license
sources.interpretation_limit: Reasoning-transcript compression is not the same estimand as exact communication between agents with complementary private observations; reported results were not independently reproduced.

sources.title: MOC: Multi-Order Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
facts_used: MOC changes topology-aware multi-hop message exposure and uses semantic-topological distillation to consolidate context
Paper evaluates with Gemma-2-27B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-V3.2-685B-Chat
At 20 agents, paper reports 1.249 million input tokens with consolidation versus 1.369 million for vanilla MAS
One seven-agent MMLU sample reports 79.7 seconds of distillation at one configuration; Gemma2-9B-Instruct is used as distiller and experiments use RTX 4090 hardware
Official code quick start describes local Gemma2 27B and Gemma2 9B distillation models
sources.interpretation_limit: Method jointly changes topology, context composition, and distillation, so it is a policy/context comparator rather than an isolated semantic codec baseline.

sources.title: Agent Action Compression Protocol (AACP) Version 1.4
sources.author: Andrew Mackay
facts_used: Defines typed pipe-delimited action/domain coordination packets with deterministic rules and LLM fallback for novel instructions
Author reports about 23 percent lower coordination token count than verbose English and workflow cost reductions in four integrations
The Datatracker document is an Internet-Draft and explicitly states such drafts are working documents without formal standing in the IETF standards process
sources.interpretation_limit: Author-reported results were not independently verified; domain-action packets are not arbitrary private-evidence message compression.

scope_note: Source-level research only; no repository was cloned, no dependencies or data were downloaded, and no code or model was run. Detailed analysis is in research/CLSR_AUDIT_V0_1.md.
